title: Spellcaster-api
description: A API FOR SPELL CASTING CODING, DON'T USE FREELY. It basicly makes spell casting mods easier.
body:
# What does this api do?

This API Helps MCreator Mods by our team, do not use as an actual api without asking for the dev api version, and do not upload it on your own, we will figure that out our selfs.

# What mods currently need you?

The mod Aligning Scepters requires this API. Any others will be added later.

# How many updates are planned?

Not many, or nothing, we don't need to do much currently.
we now have completed our plugin loader.

THAT IS ALL THIS DOES
